title.english: Sour Fruit on the Way Back

pairs.target: huíchéng qián , yú shīfu bǎ jiù bǎn jiāogěi lǎorén bǎoguǎn , tiějiā zànshí yě liúxià .
pairs.english: Before returning, Master Yu entrusted the old board to the old man for safekeeping and temporarily left the iron clamp too.
pairs.hanzi: 回程前，虞师傅把旧板交给老人保管，铁夹暂时也留下。

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe luógǎn , jiào tā bié sōng , děng qú wù suǒ de rén kànguò , zài yóu tā qǔhuí .
pairs.english: Pointing at the screw, she told him not to loosen it; after the Canal Office people had looked, she would collect it herself.
pairs.hanzi: 她指着螺杆，叫他别松，等渠务所的人看过，再由她取回。

pairs.target: lǎorén wèn shōu bu shōu bǎoguǎn qián , tā shuō kěyǐ cóng nà běn jièchūqù méi huán de shū lǐ kòu , lǎorén yìliǎnmángrán , tǎ wéi què xiǎngqǐ jiǎn lǎoshī de liǎnsè , bùgǎn xiào .
pairs.english: The old man asked whether he'd charge storage fees; she said he could deduct them from that borrowed, unreturned book. He looked blank, while Tavi remembered Instructor Jian's expression and dared not laugh.
pairs.hanzi: 老人问收不收保管钱，她说可以从那本借出去没还的书里扣，老人一脸茫然，塔维却想起简老师的脸色，不敢笑。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shōu zhǐ shí , nài lěi dūn zài pángbiān kàn tā de liǎngzhāng huà .
pairs.english: As Tavi gathered his paper, Nerai crouched beside him to look at his two drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维收纸时，奈蕾蹲在旁边看他的两张画。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi tā huì wèn nà liǎngdào hóngxiàn , biàn xiān jiěshì nǚrén hé děng chuán de rén zhēng guò shénme .
pairs.english: Thinking she would ask about the two red lines, he first explained what the woman and the man waiting for a boat had argued about.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为她会问那两道红线，便先解释女人和等船的人争过什么。

pairs.target: nài lěi tīng wán , zhǐzhe zhǐ jiǎo wèn , zhèkuài gānjìng dìfāng shìbushì tèyì gěi tā liú de .
pairs.english: After listening, Nerai pointed to the paper's corner and asked whether this clean space had been kept especially for her.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾听完，指着纸角问，这块干净地方是不是特意给她留的。

pairs.target: tā zài nàér huà le yígè wāiwāi de tǒng , tǒng biān liǎngtiáotuǐ , yìtiáo cháng , yìtiáo duǎn .
pairs.english: There she drew a crooked bucket with two legs beside it, one long, one short.
pairs.hanzi: 她在那儿画了一个歪歪的桶，桶边两条腿，一条长，一条短。

pairs.target: " zhè shì nǐ . "
pairs.english: “This is you.”
pairs.hanzi: “这是你。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ méi títǒng .
pairs.english: Tavi said he hadn't carried a bucket.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己没提桶。

pairs.target: " nà jiùshì wǒ huà cuò le . "
pairs.english: “Then I drew it wrong.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就是我画错了。”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu cā , xiào zhe bǎ zhǐ huángěi tā .
pairs.english: Without erasing it, she smiled and gave him the paper back.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有擦，笑着把纸还给他。

pairs.target: yú shīfu jiào tāmen zǒu , liǎnggè bānggōng liúzài qúkǒu shōu gōngjù , lìng yǒu zìjǐ de huíchéng ānpái .
pairs.english: Master Yu called them to leave; the two helpers stayed at the inlet to pack the tools, with their own separate plans for returning to town.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅叫他们走，两个帮工留在渠口收工具，另有自己的回城安排。

pairs.target: tā bèi qǐ mùxiá shí , tǎ wéi xiàyìshí shēnshǒu , tā méi bǎ xiázi gěi tā , zhī jiào tā tì zìjǐ bǎ jiāndài shàng fān qǐ de biān fǔpíng .
pairs.english: When she shouldered the case, Tavi instinctively reached out; she didn't give him the case, only asked him to smooth the turned edge of her shoulder strap for her.
pairs.hanzi: 她背起木匣时，塔维下意识伸手，她没把匣子给他，只叫他替自己把肩带上翻起的边抚平。

pairs.target: tā zhào zuò , cūbù mó guò zhǐ fù , xiázi luò wěn , tā biàn dào le xiè .
pairs.english: He did so; coarse cloth rubbed his fingertips, the case settled, and she thanked him.
pairs.hanzi: 他照做，粗布磨过指腹，匣子落稳，她便道了谢。

pairs.target: shàngpō zǒu de bǐ láishí màn , rìtou yǐjīng zhào dào lùmiàn zhōngyāng , càiyè shàng liàng zhe xìxìde shuǐzhū .
pairs.english: They walked uphill more slowly than on the way there; sunlight already reached the middle of the road, and tiny droplets shone on the vegetable leaves.
pairs.hanzi: 上坡走得比来时慢，日头已经照到路面中央，菜叶上亮着细细的水珠。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ dāying yīwén de shì , wèn yèlǐ háiyǒu méiyǒu chuán .
pairs.english: Remembering his promise to Iven, Tavi asked whether there were still boats at night.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起答应伊文的事，问夜里还有没有船。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō yǒuxiē zǒu , yǒuxiē bù zǒu , děi kàn qù nǎér , guò buguò zhá , yě děi kàn chēngchuán de rén kěnbukěn duō zhèng nà fèn qián .
pairs.english: Master Yu said some travelled and some didn't; it depended on where they went, whether they passed a sluice, and also depended on whether the person poling the boat was willing to earn that extra money.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说有些走，有些不走，得看去哪儿、过不过闸，也得看撑船的人肯不肯多挣那份钱。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài pángbiān jiē huà , shuō tā zuò guò bànyè de chuán , zuì pà de dào búshì hēi , shì qiántou yǒurén tí zhe dēng , què méi gàosù hòu chuán zìjǐ yǐjīng tíng le .
pairs.english: Nerai joined in beside him, saying she'd taken boats at midnight; what she feared most wasn't darkness but someone ahead carrying a light without telling the following boat he'd already stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在旁边接话，说她坐过半夜的船，最怕的倒不是黑，是前头有人提着灯，却没告诉后船自己已经停了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn nà hòulái zěnmebàn .
pairs.english: Tavi asked what happened afterwards.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问那后来怎么办。

pairs.target: tā shuō hòulái mà de hěn xiǎng , liǎngtiáochuán de rén dōu xǐng le , dào méi rén zài shuì .
pairs.english: She said afterwards the shouting was so loud that everyone on both boats woke, and nobody slept again.
pairs.hanzi: 她说后来骂得很响，两条船的人都醒了，倒没人再睡。

pairs.target: tā xiào qǐlái , yú shīfu quèshuō nà dēng ruò guà de tài dī , cóng hòumiàn běnlái jiù kànbújiàn .
pairs.english: He laughed, but Master Yu said if that lamp hung too low, it couldn't be seen from behind in the first place.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑起来，虞师傅却说那灯若挂得太低，从后面本来就看不见。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rénwéi dēng gāi guà zài nǎér zhēng le jǐjù , shuí yě méi tí jiè xìng .
pairs.english: The two argued briefly about where the lamp should hang; neither mentioned property borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人为灯该挂在哪儿争了几句，谁也没提借性。

pairs.target: tāmen biān zǒu biān shuō , jiàn tā yìzhí bù jiē huà , yú shīfu biàn wèn shìbushì nà bàngè zì hái méi rèn wán .
pairs.english: They talked as they walked; seeing he still said nothing, Master Yu asked whether he hadn't finished reading that half-character yet.
pairs.hanzi: 她们边走边说，见他一直不接话，虞师傅便问是不是那半个字还没认完。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yáotóu , zhǐzhǐ qiántou de pō , shuō liú kǒuqì páshàngqù zài jiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi shook his head, pointed to the slope ahead, and said he'd save his breath to climb it before talking.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摇头，指指前头的坡，说留口气爬上去再讲。

pairs.target: dào le běimén , nài lěi tíngxiàlái mǎi le sāngè suān guǒ .
pairs.english: At the north gate Nerai stopped to buy three sour fruits.
pairs.hanzi: 到了北门，奈蕾停下来买了三个酸果。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō zìjǐ yá bùhǎo , jiēguò qù què yǎo de bǐ shuí dōu kuài , suān de yǎnjiǎo yì suō , yòu bùkěn chéngrèn .
pairs.english: Master Yu said her teeth were bad, yet took one and bit faster than anyone; her eyes pinched from the sourness, and she refused to admit it.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说自己牙不好，接过去却咬得比谁都快，酸得眼角一缩，又不肯承认。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǐ yǎo le yìxiǎo kǒu , biàn bǎ shèngxià de bāo qǐlái , dǎsuàn dàihuíqù ràng yīwén shìshì .
pairs.english: Tavi took only a tiny bite, wrapped the rest and planned to bring it back for Iven to try.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维只咬了一小口，便把剩下的包起来，打算带回去让伊文试试。

pairs.target: nài lěi yìyǎnkànchuān , xiào zhe jiào tā biéshuō shì tā tiāo de .
pairs.english: Nerai saw through him at a glance, smiling as she told him not to say she'd picked it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾一眼看穿，笑着叫他别说是她挑的。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , tāmen àn yuē huídào xuégōng .
pairs.english: After noon they returned to the academy as agreed.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，他们按约回到学宫。

pairs.target: yú shīfu bǎ qiānguò de jìlù dàizǒu , dāying jiāng jiéguǒ zài gàosù lǎoshī ; tǎ wéi liúxià zìjǐ de cǎogǎo , shì tā dāngmiàn zhǔnxǔ de .
pairs.english: Master Yu took the signed records, promising to tell the instructors the outcome later; Tavi kept his own draft with her express permission.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅把签过的记录带走，答应将结果再告诉老师；塔维留下自己的草稿，是她当面准许的。

pairs.target: tā háiyào qù qú wù suǒ , méi zuòxià hēshuǐ , zhī jiè ménfáng de dèngzi bǎ jiāndài lǐshùn .
pairs.english: She still had to go to the Canal Office; instead of sitting for water she only borrowed the gatehouse stool to straighten her shoulder strap.
pairs.hanzi: 她还要去渠务所，没坐下喝水，只借门房的凳子把肩带理顺。

pairs.target: tā wèn tǎ wéi míngzì lǐ de wéi zěnme xiě , jì zài zìjǐ lǐng gōng de zhǐbiān , shuō zhè bànrì de jìlù yě děi suàn tā de huó .
pairs.english: She asked Tavi how to write the last character in his name, noted it on the edge of her work sheet, and said the half-day of records must count as his work too.
pairs.hanzi: 她问塔维名字里的维怎么写，记在自己领工的纸边，说这半日的记录也得算他的活。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiěgěi tā kàn , mò gān hòu tā cái zhé hǎo zhǐ , bèizhe xiázi zǒu le .
pairs.english: Tavi wrote it for her; only after the ink dried did she fold the paper and leave with her case.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维写给她看，墨干后她才折好纸，背着匣子走了。

pairs.target: nài lěi què cháo tā de xiǎobāo táitái xiàbā , tíxǐng tā , guǒzi yǐjīng bǎ zhǐdài jìnshī le .
pairs.english: But Nerai nodded toward his little bag and reminded him that the fruit had already soaked the paper wrapping.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾却朝他的小包抬抬下巴，提醒他，果子已经把纸袋浸湿了。
